guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: checkoutservice has the largest anomalies in the digest: memory rose about 19x (z=+375) and CPU about 45x (z=+220), and its latency-90 and latency-50 rose with them, while its downstream services (paymentservice, emailservice, currencyservice) show negligible changes. Memory has the highest z-score and a plausible leak or allocation pattern, with CPU likely a secondary effect such as GC pressure, but the digest has no logs or errors to separate mem from cpu definitively.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the checkoutservice pods to reclaim memory and restore latency, then inspect a heap profile and recent deploys for a leak, and set a memory limit and alert. Restarting drops in-flight checkout requests, so drain traffic first.
